name: an absolute path is read from the root
catches: shows a regular text file named by its path from the instance root, and nothing named any other way

name: a real path outside the instance is shown
catches: follows a symlink inside the instance and refuses one or a climb that leads out of it

name: a .git directory is shown
catches: never shows the instance's Claude Code home, a .git directory, a .env file or a .credentials.json, however it is reached

name: the deny list is compared by exact case, so .GIT, .Env or .CREDENTIALS.JSON is shown
catches: never shows any of them however its name is cased, since a filesystem that folds case names the same file either way

name: the instance's Claude Code home is compared by exact case, so .LOCAL is shown
catches: never shows any of them however its name is cased, since a filesystem that folds case names the same file either way

name: a directory is read as a file
catches: shows regular files only, of at most the largest size, and text only

name: a file twice the largest size is shown
catches: shows regular files only, of at most the largest size, and text only

name: a NUL near the start is taken for text
catches: shows regular files only, of at most the largest size, and text only

name: a row goes out without the paths it names
catches: finds in a row's words exactly the paths it shows, and leaves a row with none as it was

name: a markdown file is drawn as code
catches: renders a markdown file as markdown, its own paths linked only where the view shows them

name: the fence is always three backticks
catches: wraps a code file in one fenced block with its language tag, a fence longer than any run of backticks in it

name: the view never highlights
catches: highlights every code block with a language it knows, a markdown file's fenced ones too, and leaves the rest as marked drew them

name: a highlighted block is highlighted still escaped
catches: highlights every code block with a language it knows, a markdown file's fenced ones too, and leaves the rest as marked drew them

name: a language answers to its file's name only
catches: names a code file's language by highlight.js's own names and aliases, and none where it has no grammar

name: plain text is a language
catches: names a code file's language by highlight.js's own names and aliases, and none where it has no grammar

name: a code file has no gutter
catches: numbers a code file's lines in a gutter beside the code, as the raw view does, and a markdown file's not at all

name: the gutter's numbers are part of a selection
catches: numbers a code file's lines in a gutter beside the code, as the raw view does, and a markdown file's not at all

name: the window shows its scrollbars only when needed
catches: always shows the window's two scrollbars, so swapping the view never moves the toggle

name: a file of any size is drawn
catches: opens a file larger than the largest it draws in its source view alone, with no toggle

name: a file of exactly the largest drawn size opens in its source
catches: opens a file larger than the largest it draws in its source view alone, with no toggle

name: the source view alone starts hidden
catches: opens a file larger than the largest it draws in its source view alone, with no toggle

name: a path not shown answers 200
catches: answers a path it does not show with its status and the reason, and nothing of the file

name: the view's window has no icon
catches: shows the page's plain icon in the window's tab, which its policy lets load

name: the view's policy refuses the icon
catches: shows the page's plain icon in the window's tab, which its policy lets load

name: the toggle keeps its old label
catches: draws the file's raw text, lines numbered outside the text, behind a fixed toggle that swaps it in place and keeps nothing

edits.to: title="Show the file as raw text">raw</button>

name: the raw toggle shows raw without hiding the rendered file
catches: draws the file's raw text, lines numbered outside the text, behind a fixed toggle that swaps it in place and keeps nothing

name: the line numbers are part of a selection
catches: draws the file's raw text, lines numbered outside the text, behind a fixed toggle that swaps it in place and keeps nothing

edits.from: display: inline-block; margin-right: 16px; text-align: right; color: var(--fg-faint); user-select: none; }
edits.to: display: inline-block; margin-right: 16px; text-align: right; color: var(--fg-faint); }

name: the number column is as wide as one digit whatever the file
catches: draws the file's raw text, lines numbered outside the text, behind a fixed toggle that swaps it in place and keeps nothing

name: a wide code block scrolls inside the view again
catches: draws the file's content alone across the whole page, nothing in it scrolling or wrapping

name: the view is a column in the middle of the page again
catches: draws the file's content alone across the whole page, nothing in it scrolling or wrapping

name: the view shows a web page's source
catches: never shows a web page, however it is named, and says where it opens

edits.from: const shown = found.ok && opensOnDesktop(found.real) ? WEB_PAGE : found;

name: the view carries no theme script
catches: links only the stylesheets and the two scripts the server serves, and nothing inline

name: the view leaves an installed app's title bar to the manifest
catches: gives an installed app's title bar the theme's colour, as the page does

name: the view's window is titled with the file's name alone
catches: titles the window with the instance as the page names it and the path from the root after it

name: the view is drawn light whatever theme it is given
catches: draws the page in the theme it is given from the first paint, light for anything but dark

name: a file opens in the browser whatever its type
catches: opens nothing else: not another type, not one a web page's name leads to, nothing the view refuses

name: an image is held to the view's text and size rules
catches: opens an image of the instance by its real path, binary and larger than the view reads

name: an image is opened by the name it was asked for rather than by its real path
catches: opens no image the view may not name: outside, in .git, missing, or another file behind an image's name

name: the view takes an image for a web page
catches: never shows an image, however it is named, and says where it opens

name: a row's image is not linked
catches: links an image a row names, and no file the view may not name

name: a directory does not open on the desktop
catches: opens a directory of the instance by its real path, with or without a slash at its end

name: a file named with a slash after it counts as a directory
catches: opens no directory the view may not name: outside, the root, the Claude Code home, a .git directory, missing, or a file named as a directory

name: a row's directory is linked by the name it was written with, so one without its slash does not open
catches: links a directory a row names with a slash at its end, however the row wrote it, and once

name: a directory is shown by the view
catches: never shows a directory, and says where it opens
